```{er2}
#| echo: false
print("ECHO_HIDDEN_CODE")
```

```{er2}
#| output: false
print("OUTPUT_HIDDEN")
```

```{er2}
#| eval: false
print("NEVER_RUN")
```

```{er2}
#| include: false
print("NOT_INCLUDED")
```

```{er2}
#| filename: "primes.er2"
#| classes: special

```

```{er2}
#| warning: false

print("STDERR_HIDDEN", file=sys.stderr)
print("STDOUT_KEPT")
```
